Answer: B
Reason: Pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma is distinctively characterized by cystic airspaces or lucencies within areas of consolidation (often due to tumor-induced check-valve obstruction), whereas infectious pneumonia typically presents as solid consolidation; although the report notes "air bronchograms," the specific finding of cystic lucencies (Option B) is the key radiological discriminator for this malignancy over infection. *(guided by t000003)*
